key_finding: LRCH1 competes with Cdc42 for binding DOCK8 and restrains T cell migration; Lrch1 transgenic mice protected from EAE, Lrch1-deficient mice worse
context: Mouse and human CD4+ T cells, EAE model
confidence_and_limitations: High for the DOCK8 interaction; no actin-binding assay reported, so it neither supports nor refutes direct F-actin binding

claim_tested: LRCH1 acts through direct protein binding, not actin
key_finding: LRCH1 directly binds LAT, reduces LAT phosphorylation and GRB2 interaction, and promotes LAT endocytosis; Lrch1-/- mice show enhanced CD8+ T cell cytotoxicity
context: Mouse and human CD8+ T cells, CAR T cells
confidence_and_limitations: High; a second direct partner with no actin involvement, supporting an adaptor role

claim_tested: LRCH1 is a negative regulator of immune cell activation
key_finding: LRCH1 knockout in NK-92 cells increases cytotoxicity and Src/Lck activation
context: Human NK-92 and primary NK cells
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; phenotype only, no molecular mechanism involving actin

key_finding: LRCH1 knockdown increases microglial pro-inflammatory cytokines and p38/Erk1/2 activation
context: Rat primary microglia and SCI model
confidence_and_limitations: Low to moderate; knockdown phenotype, rat, no biochemistry on the CH domain

claim_tested: A single CH domain can bind F-actin
key_finding: IQGAP1(2-210) containing the CH domain binds F-actin with Kd approximately 47 microM
confidence_and_limitations: High; shows single-CH binding is possible but weak, so architecture alone cannot exclude binding

claim_tested: Smoothelin single CH domain mediates F-actin binding
key_finding: The CH domain and surrounding sequences appear sufficient for the F-actin interaction
context: Smoothelin, in vitro and in cells
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; flanking sequence contributes, so the CH domain alone may not suffice

claim_tested: A single type-3 CH domain need not bind actin
key_finding: Co-sedimentation shows CHASM/SMTNL1 has no actin-binding activity
confidence_and_limitations: High; clean negative control for the single-CH class

key_finding: SMTNL1 does not associate with F-actin in vitro despite smoothelin homology
confidence_and_limitations: High; a paralog of a binder that does not bind, so CH homology alone is not predictive

claim_tested: LRCH1 has no tandem CH actin-binding domain
key_finding: Single CH domain at 576-692 preceded by a disordered linker (mean pLDDT 44.6 over 540-575); no second CH domain in the 728-residue protein
context: AlphaFold DB model of human LRCH1
confidence_and_limitations: High for architecture; a tandem CH ABD is excluded

claim_tested: LRCH1 CH is a type-3-like single CH domain
key_finding: Nearest non-LRCH structural neighbour is calponin-1 CH (TM 0.848, 25.2% id); highest sequence identities are VAV1 27.1%, transgelin 25.7%, calponin-1 25.2%, all single type-3 CH domains
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; TM-scores among CH domains are uniformly high, so fold class rather than specific homology is the signal

claim_tested: LRCH1 CH lacks the F-actin interface signature
key_finding: Interface score 27.3 vs validated binders 54.6 (n=7, range 35.5-76.6) and non-binders 36.2 (n=5, range 32.1-48.1); binders vs non-binders one-sided p=0.0114, AUC 0.91; the ABS1 contact stretch has no structural equivalent in LRCH1
context: AlphaFold models superposed on cryo-EM F-actin complexes
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; a residue-class proxy on a structural alignment, not a binding free energy

claim_tested: No selective constraint on the actin-equivalent face
key_finding: Interface positions no more conserved than the rest of the domain (0.697 vs 0.811, p=0.104); the 33 invariant exposed residues show no spatial clustering (19.68 A vs 19.83+/-0.66 A random, p=0.404)
context: 7 metazoan LRCH1 orthologs including Drosophila Lrch
confidence_and_limitations: Low to moderate; the orthologs are closely related, so power is limited

key_finding: LRCH1 actin-equivalent face net charge 0, the same as the genuine utrophin CH1 interface, so this feature separates nothing
confidence_and_limitations: Low; reported as a null feature rather than as evidence either way
